prompt: Photorealistic nighttime environmental portrait photography in an approximately 9:16 vertical format. A slim young adult East Asian woman stands centered on an artificial-turf soccer field. She has long straight black hair with wispy blunt bangs and a thick braid falling over her left shoulder, on the viewer’s right. Facing the camera directly, she makes eye contact and gives a natural, bright toothy smile. She wears a green, gray, and brown digital-camouflage cap, an oversized matching camouflage jacket, and camouflage trousers. The jacket is open and loosely slipped down around her upper arms, revealing an ivory-white fitted cropped camisole with thin straps, a low rounded neckline edged with delicate lace, and a short row of small front buttons, exposing a narrow strip of midriff. Add a small orange cord-loop detail near one upper sleeve. Both hands hold the jacket front and tie at her lower abdomen. Use a centered, eye-level, close-range, slightly wide-angle smartphone-like three-quarter portrait, framing her from the head to mid-thigh and leaving a large area of black night sky above. The dark artificial turf has pale field markings and scattered damp-looking reflections. In the softly blurred distance are several small people, soccer goals near both side edges, trees fading into darkness, and a dark rectangular multi-story building at the back right with only a few dim windows. Illuminate her face and torso with direct on-camera flash, producing warm, bright skin tones. A tall stadium floodlight in the upper left is heavily overexposed into a brilliant white bloom surrounded by blue-white haze and subtle lens flare. Use a palette dominated by black, deep green, and cool cyan shadows, contrasted with warm skin and the ivory top, with strong contrast and a mild vignette. Keep the subject relatively sharp and the background moderately defocused, retaining subtle low-light digital noise, fine grain, slight softness, and gentle facial beautification for an authentic smartphone night-flash snapshot aesthetic. Across the entire frame, repeatedly overlay the small dark-gray sans-serif watermark text “fake reality” at low opacity in a diagonal tiled arrangement.
